fusions.name: While It's Hot
fusions.desc: A hammering blow that deals 9 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions.

fusions.name: Forge Quake
fusions.desc: Brings the hammer down in a ring of heat that deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, ignoring armour, and sets each [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Sparks off the Anvil
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 30% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and it sets them [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Rhythm of the Forge
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, heat builds on you, up to 8 stacks. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 3% more damage per stack (24% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
